title: Sample Surveys and Sampling Theory
curriculum_locator: Printed page 6, Stat H-103; laboratory Stat H-109; advanced Stat H-302; University of Dhaka four-year B.S. Honours Statistics curriculum, starting session 2023–2024

units.title: Survey Design, Target Populations and Sampling Frames
scope: Target populations and finite universe specifications
Sampling frames, listing units and observation units
Coverage error, frame omissions and duplicate representations
Survey estimands, finite population totals and superpopulation parameters
Probability sampling foundations versus non-probability selection
worked_questions: Quantifying coverage error and net undercoverage bias in population mean estimation
Frame deduplication, multiplicity adjustments and inclusion weight correction
Formulating survey estimands: finite descriptive totals versus superpopulation model parameters
units.simulation_plan: Interactive sampling frame explorer demonstrating coverage bias, duplicate listings, and undercoverage variance effects.

units.title: Simple Random Sampling and Finite Population Correction
scope: Simple random sampling without replacement (SRSWOR) and with replacement (SRSWR)
First-order and second-order inclusion probabilities
The Horvitz–Thompson estimator and sample mean unbiasedness
Finite-population variance derivation and the correction factor (1 - f)
Sample size determination for bounded margins of error and target confidence levels
worked_questions: Rigorous derivation of SRSWOR sample mean variance and the sample variance unbiased estimator s squared
Exact sample size determination for a finite population proportion with margin of error and FPC
Theoretical and empirical relative efficiency comparison between SRSWOR and SRSWR
units.simulation_plan: Finite population sampling distribution visualizer showing sample mean convergence, standard error decay, and finite population correction effects.

units.title: Stratified Random Sampling and Optimal Allocation
scope: Stratum construction principles and partition properties
Stratified sample mean estimator and exact variance derivation
Proportional allocation of sample sizes across strata
Neyman optimal allocation and cost-constrained optimum allocation
Precision gain of stratified sampling over unstratified simple random sampling
worked_questions: Lagrange multiplier derivation of Neyman optimal allocation under fixed total sample size and cost constraints
Numerical allocation and variance comparison: Proportional versus Neyman versus Equal allocation across three strata
Proving the precision hierarchy: V_opt <= V_prop <= V_ran under equal sampling costs
units.simulation_plan: Stratified sampling allocation optimizer comparing proportional, equal, and Neyman allocations with real-time variance and cost trade-offs.

units.title: Cluster Sampling and Multistage Sampling
scope: Cluster sampling rationale and operational efficiencies
Single-stage cluster sampling with equal and unequal cluster sizes
Intraclass correlation coefficient (rho) and variance inflation
Design effect (Deff) and effective sample size formulation
Two-stage cluster sampling: primary and secondary sampling units with variance decomposition
worked_questions: Analytical derivation of cluster sampling variance in terms of the intracluster correlation coefficient rho
Computing design effect and effective sample size under severe within-cluster homogeneity
Two-stage cluster sampling variance estimation and optimal allocation of SSUs per PSU under linear cost
units.simulation_plan: Cluster sampling and intracluster correlation simulator illustrating variance inflation and design effects across heterogeneous clusters.

units.title: Unequal-Probability Designs and PPS Sampling
scope: Foundations and motivation for unequal probability selection
Probability proportional to size (PPS) selection mechanisms
Hansen–Hurwitz estimator for PPS with replacement
Horvitz–Thompson estimator for PPS without replacement
Sen–Yates–Grundy variance formula and systematic PPS selection methods
worked_questions: Hansen–Hurwitz estimator variance derivation and unbiased variance estimation under PPSWR
Calculating joint inclusion probabilities pi_ij and Sen–Yates–Grundy variance under a two-draw PPSWOR scheme
Systematic PPS sampling execution with measure of size, inclusion weights, and variance stability
units.simulation_plan: PPS sampling visualizer comparing unit selection probabilities, Hansen–Hurwitz vs Horvitz–Thompson estimators, and variance stability.

units.title: Ratio, Regression and Calibration Estimation
scope: Incorporating auxiliary information in survey estimation
The ratio estimator of totals and means, Taylor series linearization for bias and MSE
Conditions under which the ratio estimator outperforms the simple sample mean
Linear regression estimator, optimal regression slope, and residual variance
Calibration weighting and the Deville–Särndal distance minimization framework
worked_questions: First-order Taylor expansion derivation of ratio estimator MSE and the correlation threshold condition rho > C_x / (2 C_y)
Linear regression estimator derivation, optimal slope, variance reduction V(y_lr) = (1-f)/n S_y^2 (1 - rho^2), and comparison with ratio
Constructing calibration weights satisfying multi-dimensional benchmark constraints using distance functions
units.simulation_plan: Auxiliary variable scatter visualizer showing ratio and regression line fits, residual spreads, and estimator MSE comparisons.

units.title: Survey Nonresponse, Imputation and Total Survey Error
scope: Unit nonresponse versus item nonresponse mechanisms
Missing data mechanisms: MCAR, MAR, and MNAR in survey sampling
Nonresponse bias formulation as a function of nonresponse rate and subgroup contrast
Weighting class adjustments, propensity score weighting, and post-stratification
Imputation techniques (mean, hot-deck, regression) and multiple imputation for honest variance estimation
Total Survey Error (TSE) framework unifying sampling and non-sampling error sources
worked_questions: Mathematical derivation of nonresponse bias under stochastic response propensities and covariance with survey variables
Weighting class adjustment: nonresponse weight construction and post-stratified variance estimation
Imputation variance distortion: single regression imputation variance underestimation and Rubin combining rules for multiple imputation
units.simulation_plan: Nonresponse bias and imputation distortion visualizer showing response propensity gradients, naive mean shifts, and multiple imputation variance recovery.

units.title: Complex-Survey Inference and Replicate Variance Estimation
scope: Characteristics of complex designs combining stratification, clustering, unequal weights, and calibration
Failure of classical IID statistical tests and naive variance formulas in complex surveys
Taylor series linearization for complex non-linear statistics
Replication variance methods: Balanced Repeated Replication (BRR) and Hadamard matrices
Jackknife Repeated Replication (JRR) and Survey Bootstrap methods
Domain and subpopulation estimation with random sub-sample sizes
Survey documentation, analytic weight construction, and quality reporting standards
worked_questions: Taylor series linearization for the variance of a complex ratio estimator in a stratified multistage design
Jackknife repeated replication (JRR): calculating delete-one-PSU replicate weights and estimating parameter variance
Domain estimation for a subpopulation: deriving unconditional variance when domain sample count n_d is random
units.simulation_plan: Replication variance estimator tool comparing Taylor linearization, Jackknife, and BRR across simulated complex survey strata.

editorial_supplements: Sampling theory is presented with complete mathematical derivations from first principles alongside modern complex survey practices. All formulas include finite population correction factors and exact inclusion probabilities. High-precision worked examination questions provide verifiable numerical computations and line-by-line algebraic proofs.
